summary.text: Doug Lloyd is the Republican nominee for Michigan Attorney General and has been Eaton County prosecuting attorney since 2013. His campaign cites more than 30 years as a prosecutor and a term as president of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association of Michigan.

paragraphs.text: Lloyd worked in the Eaton County Prosecutor's Office as an assistant prosecutor, then as a senior assistant prosecutor in the Economic Crimes Unit, and later as chief assistant prosecutor.
In 2013 the county's circuit judges appointed him prosecuting attorney, and he has since won four consecutive elections, including the county's first contested prosecutor's race since 1972.
Also in 2013, Gov. Rick Snyder appointed Lloyd to the Organized Retail Fraud Advisory Board.
He served as president of the Prosecuting Attorneys Association of Michigan in 2021–2022.
Republicans nominated him for attorney general at their August 22 convention.
His campaign website says he lives in Delta Township.

sources.title: Doug Lloyd for Michigan Attorney General
